text: where H_k consists of entire real harmonic functions satisfying `|u(x)|≤C_u(1+d_g(0,x))^k` at every point. The constant may depend on the function. No unique tangent cone is assumed. Family 361's first construction has a fixed **finite** selected degree range and exact center-regular transfer. The stronger 3D companion gives a fixed-factor violation for **each sufficiently large k followed by a metric g_k**. It also gives arbitrarily small prescribed global bilipschitz distortion, with v chosen sufficiently close to one. This is C⁰ tensor/distance comparison, not uniform control of derivatives or of the radial start as k grows.
